name: eevee-material-surface-cull-modes
purpose: Protect Eevee material surface culling for Blender 5.2 NPR builds by rendering front-facing and back-facing planes with None, Back, and Front cull modes through deferred and blended surface paths.
passCriteria: The rendered pixel brightness must show that None renders both sides, Back hides only back-facing surfaces, and Front hides only front-facing surfaces for both dithered/deferred and blended/forward material paths.
